superbol.cobol.dialect.markdownDescription:
Default COBOL dialect; `default` is equivalent to `gnucobol`. The available dialects are `default`, `gnucobol`, `cobol85`, `cobol2002`, `cobol2014`, `acu`, `acu-strict`, `bs2000`, `bs2000-strict`, `gcos`, `gcos-strict`, `ibm`, `ibm-strict`, `mf`, `mf-strict`, `mvs`, `mvs-strict`, `realia`, `realia-strict`, `rm`, `rm-strict`, `xopen`. The `-strict` version of a dialect permits using reserved words from all other dialects as custom COBOL words, as the non-strict version also reserve these words. You may also specify an absolute path to a custom GnuCOBOL dialect configuration file (see `cobc`'s `-conf` option).

*(May be overriden in project-specific `superbol.toml` files)*.

superbol.cobol.sourceFormat.title: Source Reference-format
superbol.cobol.sourceFormat.markdownDescription:
Default source reference-format.

*(May be overriden in project-specific `superbol.toml` files)*.

superbol.cobol.sourceFormatByExtension.title: Source Format by File Extension
superbol.cobol.sourceFormatByExtension.markdownDescription:
Per-extension source reference-format overrides. Each entry maps a file extension (without dot, e.g. `cbl`, `cob`) to a source format, taking precedence over the global `#superbol.cobol.sourceFormat#` setting.

*(May be overriden in project-specific `superbol.toml` files)*.

superbol.cobol.copybooks.title: Copybook Paths
superbol.cobol.copybooks.markdownDescription:
List of paths to copybooks.

*(May be overriden in project-specific `superbol.toml` files)*.

superbol.cobol.copyexts.markdownDescription:
File extensions for copybook resolution

*(May be overriden in project-specific `superbol.toml` files)*.

superbol.cobol.excludeDirs.title: Excluded Directories
superbol.cobol.excludeDirs.markdownDescription:
Directories that hold no COBOL source file to consider in project-wide operations, such as workspace symbol lookups or the analysis of every COBOL file in the workspace.  Each entry is either a directory name, that matches at any depth (e.g. `node_modules`), or a path relative to the project root when it holds a `/` (e.g. `tests/fixtures`).

Note: files excluded with `#files.exclude#` are also left out of the workspace analysis.

*(May be overriden in project-specific `superbol.toml` files)*.

superbol.cobol.mfComment.title: Micro Focus-style Comment Lines
superbol.cobol.mfComment.markdownDescription:
Treat lines with an asterisk (`*`) in the first column as comments in `fixed`, `cobol85`, and `variable` source formats (like GnuCOBOL's `-fmfcomment`).

*(May be overriden in project-specific `superbol.toml` files)*.

superbol.cobcPath.title: GnuCOBOL Compiler Executable
superbol.cobcPath.description: Path to the GnuCOBOL compiler executable.

superbol.forceSyntaxDiagnostics.markdownDescription: Force reporting of syntax diagnostics for dialects other than ``COBOL85``.

superbol.cacheInGlobalStorage.markdownDescription:
Use storage provided by Visual Studio Code for caching. When this setting is set to *false*, the cache related to the contents of a given workspace folder *f* is stored within a directory named *f*`/_superbol/cache`.

See `#superbol.cache.sizeLimit#` and `#superbol.cache.maxAge#` for how cache files are pruned.
<!-- COBOL -->

superbol.cache.sizeLimit.title: Cache Size Limit
superbol.cache.sizeLimit.markdownDescription:
Size under which the language server keeps the cache of each project, by reclaiming the entries that were used least recently whenever it writes the cache out (e.g. when it stops).  A number of bytes, with an optional `k`, `M` or `G` suffix for kibibytes, mebibytes or gibibytes (e.g. `500M`, `20G`); leave empty for no limit.
<!-- COBOL -->

superbol.cache.maxAge.title: Cache Entry Maximum Age
superbol.cache.maxAge.markdownDescription:
Number of days after which the language server reclaims cache entries that have not been used, whenever it writes the cache out (e.g. when it stops); `0` keeps them indefinitely.
<!-- COBOL -->

superbol.workspaceAnalysis.maxProcesses.title: Parallel Analysis Processes
superbol.workspaceAnalysis.maxProcesses.markdownDescription:
Maximum number of processes that the `SuperBOL: Analyze Every COBOL File in the Workspace` command runs at once; `0` stands for one less than the number of available processors.
<!-- COBOL -->

superbol.workspaceAnalysis.filesPerProce.title: Files per Analysis Process
superbol.workspaceAnalysis.filesPerProce.markdownDescription:
Number of COBOL files that each process launched by the `SuperBOL: Analyze Every COBOL File in the Workspace` command analyzes.
<!-- COBOL -->

superbol.workspaceAnalysis.publishCached.title: Report Cached Diagnostics on Startup
superbol.workspaceAnalysis.publishCached.markdownDescription:
Whenever the language server starts, report the diagnostics of the COBOL files of the workspace that it finds in its caches (e.g. after the `SuperBOL: Analyze Every COBOL File in the Workspace` command has been run in an earlier session).  Files are not analyzed: those that have changed since, or have never been analyzed, are left out until they are opened.
<!-- COBOL -->

superbol.debugger.displayVariableAttribu.title: Display Variable Attributes
superbol.debugger.displayVariableAttribu.markdownDescription:
Display storage property and field attributes (e.g. size of alphanumerics, digits and scale of numerics).
<!-- COBOL -->

superbol.debugger.libcobPath.title: GnuCOBOL Runtime Library
superbol.debugger.libcobPath.description: Path to the GnuCOBOL runtime library file.

superbol.debugger.gdbPath.title: GNU Debugger Executable
superbol.debugger.gdbPath.markdownDescription:
Path to the GNU debugger executable.
<!-- COBOL -->

superbol.debugger.cobcrunPath.title: GnuCOBOL module loader
superbol.debugger.cobcrunPath.markdownDescription:
Path to `cobcrun`, the GnuCOBOL module loader.
<!-- COBOL -->

languageModelTools.name: superbol_cobol_outline
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the structure of a COBOL source file, as computed by the SuperBOL language server: programs (and classes, methods, functions), divisions, sections, data items with their level numbers (01, 05, 77, 88, ...) and nesting, and procedure sections and paragraphs, each with its 1-based line range.  Use it to find your way in a COBOL program before reading parts of it, which is much cheaper than reading the whole file, as COBOL programs are often very long.  Data item types (PICTURE, USAGE) and statements are not included.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Outline of a COBOL program: its divisions, sections, paragraphs, and data items, with their line ranges.

filePath.description: Absolute path of the COBOL source file. Defaults to the file shown in the active editor.

maxDepth.description: Maximum nesting depth of the symbols shown (programs are at depth 1, divisions at depth 2, sections at depth 3); deeper symbols are counted but not listed.  Use 3 or 4 for a quick overview of large programs.

languageModelTools.name: superbol_cobol_find_symbol
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search the COBOL symbols of the workspace by name: programs, sections, paragraphs, data items, condition-names (level 88), and constants.  Returns, best matches first, the kind of each symbol, its name, its enclosing program or section, and its file and 1-based line range.  Use it to find which file defines a program or paragraph, e.g. the target of a CALL or PERFORM, instead of searching files.  Matching ignores case and treats `-` and `_` alike, and the letters of the query only need to appear in order (e.g. `CALCTX` matches `CALC-TAX`).  Only files that are open or that SuperBOL has already analyzed are searched.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find COBOL programs, sections, paragraphs, and data items by name, across the workspace.

query.description: Name, or part of a name, of the symbols to look for.

limit.description: Maximum number of results (50 by default).

languageModelTools.name: superbol_cobol_diagnostics
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List the errors and warnings that the SuperBOL language server reports on COBOL source files (syntax errors, unknown or ambiguous names, invalid clauses, missing copybooks, ...), with their 1-based line and column.  Use it after editing COBOL code to check that it is still valid, or to find what to fix.  Without a file, it lists the problems of every COBOL file of the workspace that SuperBOL has analyzed.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Errors and warnings that SuperBOL reports on COBOL files.

filePath.description: Absolute path of the COBOL source file. Defaults to every analyzed file of the workspace.

languageModelTools.name: superbol_cobol_project_settings
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the SuperBOL settings of the project that holds a COBOL file: COBOL dialect, source format (e.g. `fixed`, with code in columns 8-72, or `free`), source formats by file extension, directories and extensions used to find copybooks, and excluded directories.  Use it before writing COBOL code, so that it follows the expected format and dialect, or to find where the copybooks of a program are.
languageModelTools.userDescription: SuperBOL settings of a COBOL project: dialect, source format, copybook paths.

filePath.description: Absolute path of the COBOL source file. Defaults to the file shown in the active editor, or else the first workspace folder.

languageModelTools.name: superbol_cobol_control_flow
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the control flow graph of a COBOL program, or of one of its sections, between paragraphs and sections: for each one, which paragraphs or sections it PERFORMs, which it reaches with GO TO, and which it falls through to, with 1-based line ranges.  Use it to understand the overall logic of a program, or what may run before or after a given paragraph, without reading every statement.  When a file holds several programs, or to get the graph of one section, the tool lists the graph names that `name` accepts.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Control flow between the paragraphs and sections of a COBOL program.

filePath.description: Absolute path of the COBOL source file. Defaults to the file shown in the active editor.

name.description: Name of the graph: a program name, or a section name followed by its program name in parentheses, e.g. `MAIN-SECTION (PAYROLL)`.  Defaults to the program of the file, when it holds only one.

executable.description: Build an executable program instead of a module

cobcPath.title: GnuCOBOL Compiler Executable
cobcPath.markdownDescription: Path to the GnuCOBOL compiler executable; when `null` or "", defaults to the value of "superbol.cobcPath" from the workspace configuration, if defined, to "cobc" otherwise.

listingsTarget.title: Output file or directory for preprocessed program listings
listingsTarget.markdownDescription: Path to a directory where preprocessed program listings are generated; no listing is saved when `null`.

name: SuperBOL
